messages:
elaine: quick sync — planning a privacy-gated EU rollout for model-v2. customer-driven asks include per-tenant opt-in and KMS escrow. thinking staged canary + explicit fallback. any immediate blockers?

kevin: +1. staging plan idea: wave1 internal 5%, wave2 beta customers 10%, wave3 all EU 100%. requires region pinning + warm pools.

maria: SRE note — need eu-west warm pools and prewarmed kv-cache. p95 budget 200ms, otherwise auto-fallback. also dependency on cross-region routing rules.

sam: product-ops: agree on 3 waves. we should gate wave2 with telemetry thresholds (latency, error-rate, hallucination-regressions on eval set). add manual hold + kill-switch.

nora: sales: two enterprise customers requested opt-in toggles and audit logs. they need per-tenant flag and KMS-backed key for exported logs.

kevin: sample flag config (draft):
```
flag: modelv2_eu
rules:
  - audience: internal
    pct: 5
  - audience: enterprise_beta
    pct: 10
  - region: eu
    pct: 100
fallback: model_v1
telemetry: [latency_p95, error_rate, eval_regressions]
kms: customer_kms_required
```

maria: add circuit-breaker: if error_rate > 1.5% for 5m OR latency_p95 > 300ms for 5m then route to fallback and post incident. also capture sample traces for failed requests.

sam: agree. telemetry dashboards: can we instrument a synthetic eval probe hitting the same prompt set every 5m? need that for quality gating.

kevin: yes — we'll wire synthetic probe + per-route traces. also need a flag escrow checklist for security: k/s owner, KMS key rotation plan, and opt-in audit fields.

elaine: action items: 1) @kevin draft rollout PR with flag config and infra checklist; 2) @maria prepare warm-pool runbook and circuit-breaker config; 3) @sam add telemetry eval set + dashboards; 4) @nora confirm customer opt-in contract text. target: start wave1 internal canary next Tue.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled: wave1 (internal 5%) -> starting canary at 1754443210. monitor: https://console.redwood/rollouts/1754443210

nora: :thumbsup: will ping legal for the contract clause today.

kevin: once wave1 is green we'll run 24h bake then propose wave2. if any guardrails fail we hold and escalate.

elaine: thanks all — follow-ups in the rollout doc (roadmap/quarterly/priv-gate-eu.md). post-canary sync 1hr after start.
